summary.text: Jenna Jacobson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 50 and is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026, general election.
She is a housing program specialist and former Village of Oregon trustee.

paragraphs.text: Jenna Jacobson was born in Brenham, Texas, and lives in Oregon, Wisconsin.
She graduated from Frederic High School in 2000 and earned a bachelor's degree in consumer financial planning from Purdue University in 2008.

Her career experience includes working as a housing program specialist for the Dane County housing access and affordability division, and she served on the Village of Oregon board of trustees from 2017 to 2022.
Jacobson has served in the Assembly since 2023 and is not seeking re-election to District 50 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Agriculture, Financial Institutions, Health, Sporting Heritage, and Ways and Means committees.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she had prioritized housing affordability as an Oregon village trustee.
